candidates.name: glicko_team_uncertainty
candidates.label: Glicko команд с неопределённостью
candidates.hypothesis: Glicko reacts faster to uncertain team strength and discounts gaps unsupported by history.
candidates.fixed_parameters: 1500/350 initial rating/RD, RD floor 30; RD 50 reaches 350 after 180 inactive days; one completed map per update

candidates.name: glicko_current_players
candidates.label: Glicko фактических игроков
candidates.hypothesis: Uncertainty-aware player ratings can handle transfers and new players better. This is an experimental squad adaptation of Glicko.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Same Glicko constants; player update against opposing squad mean; squad RD uses RMS, accounting conservatively for correlated teammates

candidates.name: inactivity_regression
candidates.label: Ослабление рейтинга после перерывов
candidates.hypothesis: Old team/player strength regresses toward the initial rating during inactivity.
candidates.fixed_parameters: 180-day half-life, team K24 and player K20

candidates.name: current_tournament_form
candidates.label: Форма в текущем турнире
candidates.hypothesis: Performance within the current league can capture event-specific adaptation beyond general recent form.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Last 50 maps, 90-day cap, 14-day half-life, 8-map prior; at least three retained players

candidates.name: roster_aware_head_to_head
candidates.label: Очные встречи с учётом составов
candidates.hypothesis: Opponent-specific past results may reveal a matchup advantage after correcting for expected strength and changed rosters.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Last 20 meetings, 180-day cap, 60-day half-life, 8-map prior; at least three retained players on both sides

candidates.name: sample_supported_pairs
candidates.label: Связки с поправкой на объём истории
candidates.hypothesis: Rare hero pairs should have less influence than well-observed combinations.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Scale pair indicators by n/(n+40); n includes only earlier completed exposures

candidates.name: supported_hero_triples
candidates.label: Подтверждённые сочетания трёх героев
candidates.hypothesis: Three-hero combinations can express a draft plan absent from pairwise interactions.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Minimum 12 earlier exposures; signed magnitude 0.25*n/(n+30)

candidates.name: learned_player_hero_offsets
candidates.label: Отдельные веса игрока на конкретном герое
candidates.hypothesis: Individual player/hero offsets can retain signature information lost by an averaged shared win-rate feature.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Minimum 8 earlier exposures; signed magnitude 0.5*n/(n+20); unknown identities add no category

candidates.name: learned_team_hero_offsets
candidates.label: Отдельные веса героев стабильной команды
candidates.hypothesis: Stable-team proficiency with a hero may reflect collective execution beyond individual hero comfort.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Minimum 8 earlier exposures and three retained players; magnitude 0.5*n/(n+20)*retention

candidates.name: critical_counter_and_synergy
candidates.label: Самые сильные и слабые матчапы драфта
candidates.hypothesis: A draft's most advantaged or exposed hero and strongest or weakest synergy may matter more than a global average.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Current-patch opponent-adjusted historical residuals; 40-map prior; hero-level average against five opponents

candidates.name: league_balanced_training
candidates.label: Баланс веса разных лиг
candidates.hypothesis: Inverse square-root league frequency prevents prolific leagues dominating the fit while retaining all competitions.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Training-only counts; factors capped 0.25-4; mean sample weight one

candidates.name: series_balanced_training
candidates.label: Баланс веса разных серий
candidates.hypothesis: Reduce the disproportionate weight of long, correlated series.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Inverse number of training maps per exact league/series; bounded factors; unknown series uses map identity

candidates.name: patch_balanced_training
candidates.label: Баланс веса разных патчей
candidates.hypothesis: A patch with many small-league games should not dominate shared hero weights.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Training-only inverse square-root patch frequency; bounded relative factors

candidates.name: stable_roster_training
candidates.label: Обучение на известных стабильных составах
candidates.hypothesis: Mostly retained, known rosters reduce noise between team ratings and outcomes.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Both teams retain at least four of five known players from the latest completed map; filter fitting only, preserve all final maps

candidates.name: pooled_tier1_calibration
candidates.label: Общая калибровка с поправкой для Tier 1
candidates.hypothesis: Partially pooled Tier 1 adjustments can adapt to elite matches without discarding other calibration observations.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Global score/team/player calibration plus Tier 1 indicator and interactions; calibration C=0.2

candidates.name: elastic_sparse_draft
candidates.label: Отбор лишних признаков через elastic net
candidates.hypothesis: Sparse regularization may remove unhelpful hero-pair weights while preserving correlated useful signals.
candidates.fixed_parameters: SAGA, l1_ratio 0.5, maximum 3000 iterations, seed 42

candidates.name: extra_trees_draft
candidates.label: Ансамбль случайных деревьев
candidates.hypothesis: Randomized trees may find draft/rating interactions with a different bias and variance tradeoff from histogram boosting.
candidates.fixed_parameters: 300 trees, depth 12, minimum leaf 40, max_features 0.6, log_loss criterion, seed 42

candidates.name: regularized_small_network
candidates.label: Небольшая нейросеть с регуляризацией
candidates.hypothesis: Smooth nonlinear hero/rating interactions may be missed by shallow tree partitions.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Training-only StandardScaler; 32-unit layer, alpha 20, L-BFGS, maximum 500 iterations/2000 evaluations; no random validation, seed 42

candidates.name: ratings_then_draft_residual
candidates.label: Сначала сила игроков, затем поправка драфта
candidates.hypothesis: Separate strength fitting from draft corrections so sparse hero pairs do not distort the strength baseline.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Both stages fit training labels only; strength and draft L2 C=0.15; deterministic L-BFGS-B and analytic gradient

candidates.name: smooth_rating_curves
candidates.label: Плавные нелинейные эффекты рейтингов
candidates.hypothesis: Rating and comfort effects need not follow one shared linear slope for weak and elite matchups.
candidates.fixed_parameters: Five training-quantile spline knots, degree two, linear extrapolation on team/player/comfort fields; retain sparse hero and pair weights
